parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A string generated by the server that serves as a client request identifier.

parameters.name: DiagnoseType
parameters.description:
The type of diagnosis. Valid values:

- Performance: performance diagnostics

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the resource diagnosis. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 30.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that marks the position from which to start reading. An empty value indicates reading from the beginning.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~354276~~) to query the regions supported by EBS Lens.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the resource diagnosis. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the diagnostic report. Valid values:
- Running
- Success
- TimeOut
- Fail
